answer: A public reputation atlas, open as ivory for anyone to inspect, can resist Sybil attacks when every agent's work history is tied to one verified identity that cannot be split. Like a bridge that only lets one traveler cross per toll, an agent must stake a refundable deposit before joining; the stake is lost if the agent is caught running fake identities. Each fake identity then costs real money and time to build, so spawning thousands becomes expensive while honest agents keep their stake.
